原图目视观察：
纸塑折面、哑光深色盘和分层纸汽在原图明显，与A水墨不同；鸡身金赭连续，桑枝居辅助位置。模型仍画成大特写，远超预定占幅，织纸皱纹也较密；不标作商品照片或真实扒鸡工艺记录。无可见行政界线/标记/文字。

文化与想象边界：
只从文化来源取一般题材、地域和材料线索，不复制来源照片或具体作者作品。新图不继承实拍摄影者署名或许可。来源只支持culturalBasis各项列明范围；器形、装饰、场景与人物均可为原创想象，不给它们编造作者、年代、馆藏或奖项。界面另加AI标识、地名、来源和操作。
用户确认的是市域分拆轮廓方向，不是全部最终画作或行政地图已审定。确认位置为上述confirmationRecordPath，旧预审中的暂停文字由统筹最新明确恢复/扩城授权覆盖。

固定映射：
完整实际方图对应referenceFrame全幅含留边。scale=f/实际宽= f/实际高；在固定frame.x/y绘制f×f，再用原global-mask和evenodd裁切。不先裁去留边，不自动cover、mapFocus、zoom、旋转或移动。subjectCoreInReference仅是生成意图，非实测遮罩结论。
若返回非方形，必须保留实际尺寸并进入映射待核，不拉伸/裁切冒充。

完整实际生成提示词：
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: ONE finished independent SQUARE 1:1 Chinese cultural artwork, full bleed, maximum available native clarity, made for a fixed city-template reference frame. Not a webpage background, poster, map, diagram, sticker, comparison board or multi-panel collage.
Input image 1: the city's outline-reference.png, supplied as COMPOSITION REFERENCE ONLY. The ENTIRE square, including outside margins, is the fixed reference canvas. Preserve its full-square coordinate correspondence. Do not tightly crop the silhouette, zoom it, rotate or reframe. The pale silhouette only tells which parts of the painting will later remain visible.
DO NOT paint the reference silhouette, pale fill, boundary line, blank outside field or any map shape. Instead make a natural complete cultural painting across ALL FOUR EDGES, with the important subject positioned as specified below. The exact administrative edge will be clipped independently by the frontend's original SVG, never by the image model. No green circles, yellow bands, safety markers, outlines, geographic shapes, frames or labels.
One dominant cultural subject; supporting landscape, objects or people stay secondary. Original imagined scenes, buildings, figures and cultural objects are allowed, but not a real-site photograph, collection object, maker's work or historical reconstruction. Never copy a specific artist's composition or craft object.
No text of any kind: no Chinese characters, calligraphy, inscriptions, signatures, seals, logos, numbers, watermarks, QR codes, city labels or UI.
Series family: tangible handmade Chinese art, disciplined large shapes and legible silhouette, visible brush/material, differentiated city palette and arrangement but harmonious neutral fibers. No photorealistic product photography, glossy CGI, generic digital swirls or synthetic gradient wallpaper. Make the artwork fill a square canvas.
City-specific primary request: Dezhou traditional braised whole chicken as an ORIGINAL Chinese food-art still life, on ONE compact dark shallow plate. The whole prepared chicken is the main hero, not a live bird and not an advertisement. Recognizable complete cooked body with neatly folded wings and tucked legs; no feathers, no exposed raw flesh, no gore, no butcher scene, no branded packaging. A natural compact continuous silhouette, not separated chicken pieces. Only one very small mulberry twig with a few leaves and purple fruits as supporting regional reference, and a restrained steam brush curve. No second vessel, no utensils, no mountain scene, no people.
Composition/framing: Interpret input as full-square reference including margins. The essential readable food body is centered slightly left of the entire square at (0.465,0.50). Chicken+plate should occupy approximately x=0.31–0.61, y=0.41–0.59, a compact broad oval middle-band arrangement, not a giant platter filling the frame. Keep wings, tucked legs and neck close to the body so recognition survives clipping; plate rim is subordinate. Rising faint steam flows diagonally toward the upper-right extension of the reference, while quiet mulberry/cloth strokes can trail lower. Do not paint the boundary shape. Warm paper, ink cloth-shadow and broad subtle brush atmosphere extend naturally to all four edges, not a white product-cutout or empty map surround. Large readable masses, minimal garnishes, no dense ornament or tiny detail texture.
B medium: a clearly handmade craft/material-led illustration, truly different from an ink painting. Visible original cut, carved, layered, modeled or fibrous material is primary, with selective ink contours or washes connecting it to Chinese art. Not a photo, photoreal product mockup or glossy CGI. Keep broad readable shapes instead of relying on tiny decoration.
Specific medium/palette: contemporary handmade paper-sculpture illustration. The cooked chicken is constructed from smooth broad softly folded amber/ochre paper volumes, with cut/fold seams sparingly visible; still unmistakably a prepared whole chicken, not a rooster mascot, origami bird, toy or live hen. It sits on a compact matte charcoal-black clay-like plate with subtle hand-pressed grain, a creative material choice, not a purported archaeological vessel. No vessel ornament. Cream and slightly smoky-gray layered rice-paper cloth surround it, one restrained red-brown edge accent; a small dark mulberry twig with two or three muted purple fruits. Delicate selective ink shadows, broad tactile forms. Avoid dense paper scales, shiny roast skin, product photography or glossy CGI. Paper sculpture is the chosen art medium, not a claim of a specific local heritage process.
